name: easy-mvt
description: Friendly desktop interface for Amnesty International's Mobile Verification Toolkit (unofficial)
author: SsybaSgyu (https://github.com/SsybaSgyu)

scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/fetch-uv.js darwin arm64 && node scripts/fetch-uv.js darwin x64 && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/fetch-uv.js win32 x64 && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/fetch-uv.js linux x64 && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never

extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: To open phone backups or reports you saved on the Desktop.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: To save scan results in Documents/MVT Results.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: To open phone reports you downloaded.
